attachedIllustration.titleAr: إنفوجرام دلالات جلطة القلب ونخر عضلة القلب (Cardiac Biomarkers Infogram)
attachedIllustration.titleEn: Myocardial Infarction Biomarker Kinetic Curves Infogram
attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryAr: مخطط زمني حركي دقيق لتصاعد وهبوط دلالات النخر القلبي بعد الاحتشاء القلبي: تروبونين عالي الحساسية (hs-Troponin I)، كرياتين كيناز النطاق القلبي (CK-MB)، والميوجلوبين.
attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryEn: Kinetic timeline curves illustrating cardiac biomarker release following acute myocardial infarction: onset, peak, and normalization timeline of Troponin I vs CK-MB vs Myoglobin.
keyDiagnosticPoints: Troponin I / T: Gold standard marker. Rises at 3-4 hours, peaks at 12-24 hours, remains elevated 7-14 days
High-Sensitivity Troponin (hs-cTnI): Detects myocardial injury within 1-2 hours of symptom onset
CK-MB: Rises at 4-6 hours, peaks at 18-24 hours, normalizes within 48-72 hours (useful for re-infarction)
BNP / NT-proBNP: Ventricular stretch biomarker for diagnosing and staging Congestive Heart Failure
LDH: Late cardiac marker, peaks at 48-72 hours, persists up to 10 days
attachedIllustration.differentialDiagnosis: ACS vs Non-ischemic troponin elevation (PE, sepsis, renal failure, severe myocarditis).

attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryAr: مخطط مرئي لمراحل تكون اللويحة التصلبية الشريانية الناتجة عن أكسدة كوليسترول LDL وترسب الخلايا الرغوية (Foam cells)، مع حدود الأهداف العلاجية للدهون طبقاً للتوصيات العالمية.
attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryEn: Visual pathophysiological timeline of atherosclerosis: endothelial injury -> oxidized LDL accumulation -> macrophage foam cell formation -> fibrous cap plaque rupture.
keyDiagnosticPoints: Total Cholesterol: Desirable < 200 mg/dL | Borderline: 200-239 | High >= 240
LDL-C (Bad): Optimal < 100 mg/dL (< 70 or < 55 in very high risk CAD patients)
HDL-C (Protective): > 40 mg/dL in males, > 50 mg/dL in females
Triglycerides: Normal < 150 mg/dL | High 200-499 | Very high >= 500 (Pancreatitis risk)
Non-HDL-C: Total Cholesterol minus HDL (Comprehensive atherogenic particle estimate)
attachedIllustration.differentialDiagnosis: Primary vs Secondary dyslipidemia (Hypothyroidism, Nephrotic syndrome, Diabetes).

parameters.textReference: Mature differential, no toxic granules, vacuoles, or blasts

parameters.name: Platelet Morphology
parameters.textReference: Adequate on smear, normal aggregation, no giant forms

attachedIllustration.titleAr: شريحة دم محيطي طبيعية (Normal Peripheral Blood Smear)
attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryAr: كرات دم حمراء طبيعية الحجم ومتساوية الصبغ (Normocytic Normochromic) مع مساحة شحوب مركزي طبيعية تعادل ثلث قطر الخلية، مع توزيع طبيعي لكرات الدم البيضاء والصفائح الدموية.
attachedIllustration.pathologySummaryEn: Normocytic, normochromic erythrocytes with normal central pallor (~1/3 diameter). Adequate platelets and normal differential leucocytic morphology.
keyDiagnosticPoints: MCV: 80 - 98 fL | MCH: 27 - 33 pg | MCHC: 32 - 36 g/dL
RBCs: uniform size and biconcave disc shape
WBC differential within normal reference intervals
Platelets: 150 - 450 x10^3/µL with normal granular appearance
attachedIllustration.differentialDiagnosis: No cytopenias or dysplastic features identified.

bloodFilmFindings.rbcMorphology: Normocytic normochromic RBCs. No significant anisopoikilocytosis.
bloodFilmFindings.wbcMorphology: Normal mature leukocyte series. No toxic granulation or atypical forms.
bloodFilmFindings.plateletMorphology: Adequate in number and well-distributed on peripheral smear.
bloodFilmFindings.differentialSummary: Differential leukocyte count within physiological reference intervals.
